title: pvEnvironmentAnnotation
body:
## pvEnvironmentAnnotation

Produces a text annotation stating the user name, system name, date and time and, optionally, the input's file name, for stamping provenance on images. ParaView marks its output port as text: it is an annotation, not a dataset, and the input data are not passed through. The text depends on the machine, user and run time.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Date/time and user name differ between runs; disable them when images are compared across runs or machines.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `EnvironmentAnnotation`. Identity: `filters/EnvironmentAnnotation`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. ParaView: Set the input of the filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DisplayDate` | Toggle Date/Time Visibility. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DisplayFileName` | Toggle File Name Visibility. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DisplayFilePath` | Toggle Show Full File Path. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DisplaySystemName` | Toggle System Name Visibility. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DisplayUserName` | Toggle User Name Visibility. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileName` | Annotation of file name. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvEnvironmentAnnotation",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": [
      "UPSTREAM_Input"
    ]
  }
}
```
